description: A fictional cartoon science-fiction toy freeze-ray gadget, a chunky toy-like game prop (not a real object, no working parts). A slim rounded light grey body, fattest at the rear with a rounded end, tapering forward into a long thin neck. At the front end, behind a mid grey collar ring, a wide pale blue open funnel flaring forward, slightly flattened so it is wider than it is tall. Standing upright on top of the body at the rear, a big glass ball tank filled flat bright ice blue, sitting in a mid grey collar ring. A curved mid grey pipe runs from that collar forward, arching above the body, and down into a small grey socket on top of the neck just behind the funnel. Three short pale blue rounded fins stand in a row on top of the body under the pipe. Underneath at the rear a dark navy handle raked backward, with a bright white curved finger lever inside a rounded mid grey loop in front of the handle. On the left flank of the rounded rear end, a small round bright orange gauge dial in a mid grey rim. A bright orange valve wheel is on the right flank of the body.
proportions: About 0.55 m long, 0.14 m wide and 0.32 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.93 : 1 : 2.29)
sides: the small orange gauge dial is on the left flank at the rear only; the bright orange valve wheel is on the right flank only; everything else is symmetric left to right (ball tank, pipe, fins, funnel and handle all on the centre line).

faces.side: The prop is level: the body axis exactly horizontal, the pale blue funnel at the left end of the image opening to the left, the grey collar, the long light grey neck widening to the fat rounded rear at the right end of the image; the big ice blue ball tank stands on top near the right end in its grey collar, the grey pipe arches from the collar forward and down to the neck near the funnel, the three pale blue fins stand in a row on top of the body under the pipe; the orange gauge dial is on the flank at the rear end; the dark navy handle hangs below the rear of the body, raked toward the right, with the white finger lever and grey loop in front of it.
faces.front: Seen from the front end: the wide pale blue funnel mouth as a flattened oval in the middle, with a darker blue centre; the big ice blue ball tank stands above it on the centre line, the thin grey pipe and a pale blue fin on the centre line between them; the grey loop and the dark navy handle hang below the funnel on the centre line.
faces.rear: Seen from the rear end: the rounded light grey end of the body in the middle, the pale blue funnel rim showing left and right of it behind, the big ice blue ball tank on its grey collar above on the centre line, the dark navy handle hanging below on the centre line and hiding the finger lever.
faces.top: Seen from above: the pale blue funnel at the left end, wider than the body; the long light grey body narrow at the left and fat at the right; the ball tank as a big ice blue circle on the centre line near the right end, the grey pipe as a straight strip along the centre line from the tank to the neck, the three fins as short thin strips on the centre line under it; the handle is hidden under the body.
